title: A song in the water
summary: A little water spirit sings one note. Far away, a sleeping tree answers.
alt: Pink and blue blob friends meet a golden water spirit beside a dusk stream, with a giant tree across the valley.
lines: פעם, כל היער שר יחד. עכשיו נשאר רק צליל אחד.
Once, the whole forest sang together. Now only one note remains.
Did you hear? The tree answered me!
Let’s find out what’s over there.
shots: 0–6s · Close on small hands touching the stream. Golden ripples appear.
6–15s · A tiny spirit rises and sings one clear note.
15–25s · Pull back: a light answers inside the distant tree. A trail opens beside the waterfall.
play: Touch the ripple to begin the journey.
change: The giant tree becomes the destination on the map.
hook: What is waiting inside that tree?
bridge: Stages 1–5 · Familiar Memory, Shop and House activities help the first forest friends. Each completion extends the light trail.

title: Behind the waterfall
summary: A hidden garden holds the first seed of the forest’s song.
alt: The friends discover a golden seed in a stone flower behind a sunlit waterfall.
lines: יש כאן שביל! ממש מאחורי המים!
There’s a path! Right behind the water!
בתוך הפרח חיכה זרע של שיר.
Inside the flower waited a seed of song.
shots: 0–7s · Follow the companion through the curtain of water.
7–15s · A stone flower opens. The first seed gives a soft musical note.
15–22s · The heroes lift it; hanging seed lanterns light a new passage.
play: Tap the stone flower. The seed floats into the journey pouch.
change: First song seed collected; the hidden garden stays lit.
hook: Where does this new passage lead?
bridge: Stages 6–10 · Help river creatures through familiar learning activities. Their gratitude opens the crossing.

title: The river joins in
summary: The river creatures unfold a bridge of giant lily pads. The journey begins to move.
alt: Pink and blue blobs hop onto wide lily pads while friendly river creatures watch at sunset.
lines: Thanks for helping! Ready to cross?
shots: 0–6s · A river creature whistles. Lily pads unfold one after another.
6–14s · The heroes bounce across. Their floating friend proudly attempts a jump.
14–20s · From the far bank, lanterns appear among enormous roots.
play: Tap a broad leaf for a little celebratory bounce. No timing test.
change: A permanent crossing connects the two sides of the map.
bridge: Stages 11–15 · Meet the woodland community. Shop requests now feel like helping travelers prepare for the road.

title: Lanterns in the roots
summary: The travelers find a bustling market—and learn that someone is dreaming inside the tree.
alt: A warm lantern market inside giant roots, with woodland merchants and the blob heroes carrying a picnic basket.
lines: קחו צידה לדרך. העץ עוד רחוק.
Take some food for the journey. The tree is still far away.
And this cookie? Is it for the journey too?
כן. וכשתגיעו, תקשיבו. שומר היער שר מתוך שינה.
Yes. And when you arrive, listen. The forest guardian sings in his sleep.
shots: 0–8s · Enter the warm market; familiar friends wave from their stalls.
8–19s · A hedgehog packs the basket. The spirit inspects a cookie upside down.
19–28s · The merchant points to a passage marked with a feather carving.
play: Accept the picnic basket from the shopkeeper.
change: The village stays lively; its residents become returning friends.
bridge: Stages 16–20 · Listen, recognize and arrange familiar vocabulary. Each small success makes the route to the echo cavern clearer.

title: Someone answers
summary: A tiny note receives a giant answer. A feather carving reveals the guardian’s shape.
alt: A moonlit crystal cavern with a mirror lake, golden sound ripples and a feathered guardian mural.
lines: זה לא הקול שלי. מישהו שר איתנו!
That isn’t my voice. Someone is singing with us!
shots: 0–8s · A single note travels across the mirror lake. Leave a short, quiet pause.
8–17s · A deeper, warm note answers. The feather mural shines softly.
17–25s · A second seed rises from the water; the root doorway opens.
play: Touch the answering ripple to collect the second song seed.
change: Second seed collected; an illuminated doorway replaces the closed passage.
hook: The voice sounds enormous. What will its owner look like?
bridge: Stages 21–25 · Continue the learning route into the roots. The guardian’s three-note melody becomes clearer as the children approach.

title: The sleeping guardian
summary: The mysterious voice belongs to an enormous, gentle bird. A leaf tickles its beak.
alt: A huge friendly cream-feathered guardian sleeps inside a living tree, with a leaf on its beak and the tiny heroes nearby.
lines: So you’re the one who was singing to us.
shots: 0–9s · Camera climbs from tiny heroes to the enormous sleeping bird.
9–18s · A leaf lands on its beak. A sleepy puff sends it drifting onto the blue hero.
18–30s · The guardian hums two notes. The third fades. One final seed-shaped hollow lights up.
play: Brush away the little leaf. The guardian gives a sleepy smile.
change: The destination becomes a friend who needs help.
hook: Can we find the missing note?
bridge: Stages 26–30 · Help the last root-garden residents. Completing their activities reveals the third song seed.

title: Three little lights
summary: The last seed completes the collection. Three lights reconnect the roots to the guardian.
alt: Three stone flower bowls hold glowing seeds as the two heroes place the final one, with the guardian asleep behind them.
lines: כל זרע שמר חלק מהשיר. יחד, הם האירו את השורשים.
Each seed held a part of the song. Together, they lit the roots.
עכשיו נעזור לו לשיר אותם יחד.
Now let’s help him sing them together.
shots: 0–7s · The last seed joins the two already in the pouch.
7–17s · Place the three seeds in the stone flowers. Light runs into the roots.
17–24s · The guardian stirs; a path rises gently toward its resting place.
play: Place each seed into its flower. No wrong slot.
change: All three song seeds are visible at the tree; flowers open along its roots.
hook: What happens when the whole song returns?
bridge: Stages 31–35 · The last familiar activities prepare the awakening. Keep help available; the story does not depend on perfect scores.

title: One eye opens
summary: The guardian recognizes its helpers. The final stage will give it back its full song.
alt: The huge feathered guardian opens one warm eye and begins raising a wing over the two little heroes.
lines: I heard you… all the way here.
shots: 0–7s · One friendly eye opens. The music holds a gentle unfinished phrase.
7–14s · One wing lifts. Dim strands of song begin turning into light.
14–20s · The guardian lowers its head to the children; three flowers await the final challenge.
play: Touch the lit flower to enter stage 36.
change: The finale opens: three short activities, one continuous awakening.
hook: We’re going to see those wings open.
bridge: Stage 36 · Memory reconnects the song; Shop gathers its familiar objects; House places them. Each completed round wakes one part of the guardian.

title: Our first flight
summary: The guardian takes the heroes above the world they restored. Every place below is familiar.
alt: The awakened cream-feathered guardian carries both blob heroes safely over a glowing valley at sunrise.
lines: Now it’s my turn to show you something.
Look! Our bridge! And the village!
היער שוב שר. ובשיר שלו היו גם הקולות שלנו.
The forest sang again. And our voices were part of its song.
shots: 0–10s · Full wings unfold. The heroes settle into a soft nest of feathers.
10–27s · A smooth flight passes the waterfall, crossing, village and blooming tree.
27–35s · Friends wave from below. Hold on a celebration portrait, then return to the restored map.
play: Point out the places you recognize. Save the journey portrait to the story album.
change: A permanently restored world and a replayable ending; the adventure has a complete finish.
hook: We did this. Look how far we came.
bridge: After the journey · Revisit favorite games and replay unlocked scenes. No new task is required to keep the happy ending.
